entities.name: Javad Nasrin
entities.description: A relic hunter and the journal's author, who leads an expedition from Kabira to Turntimber to find the Seer's Sundial.

entities.name: Ghazzan
entities.description: A nearly silent minotaur expeditioner who wields a Makindi longaxe and dies near the Crypt of Agadeem.

entities.name: Sali Oran
entities.description: A merfolk lullmage hired to soothe storms and the Roil, who accompanies Javad to the end.

entities.name: Keeda
entities.description: A goblin trapfinder of the Lavastep tribe, who falls into a viper pit in Turntimber.

entities.name: Seer's Sundial
entities.description: A massive ancient stone hemispherium on a dais in Turntimber whose shadows project messages onto a rune-inscribed bowl.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: A land-disturbing force on Zendikar that can move travelers off course.

entities.name: Crypt of Agadeem
entities.description: A cave-mouthed crypt in Agadeem in whose range a creature seized Ghazzan.

entities.name: Turntimber
entities.description: A forest of serpentine trees and wild elves where the Seer's Sundial stands.

entities.name: Agadeem
entities.description: A hedron-strewn region of Zendikar crossed by the expedition.

entities.name: Kabira
entities.description: The place on Zendikar from which the expedition sets out.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: The continent of Zendikar that Javad has long traveled.

entities.name: Serpentcutter
entities.description: A skiff whose captain trades with the expedition for passage over the Silundi Sea.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which the expedition takes place.

events.summary: Javad's expedition sets out from Kabira with a hurda packbeast, hoping to reach Turntimber.
events.quote: The sun was relentless all this first day, carving a searing line in the sky over the hedron-strewn flats of Agadeem, its disk like the gaze of an unshuttered eye.

events.summary: Javad introduces his hired party: Ghazzan, Sali Oran and Keeda.
events.quote: I've hired Ghazzan, the first minotaur I've expeditioned with, a nearly silent but unmistakably strong man who favors the Makindi longaxe to the more traditional machete

events.summary: The Roil moves the party near the Crypt of Agadeem, where a creature drags Ghazzan to his death.
events.quote: We woke to Ghazzan's disconcerting, bleating cries, and discovered him being dragged in the direction of the cave-maw of the too-near Crypt.

events.summary: The surviving party flees the Crypt and crosses the Silundi Sea aboard the Serpentcutter.
events.quote: We are now aboard the Serpentcutter , having bartered our furs and Ghazzan's longaxe to its captain

events.summary: Keeda falls into a viper pit in Turntimber and dies, releasing a basilisk.
events.quote: His instincts were enough to save us from the pit of vipers, but not enough to prevent him from falling into it himself, nor to prevent the release of the basilisk that followed

events.summary: On the solstice, Javad and Sali Oran find the Seer's Sundial on a hilltop dais in Turntimber and study its shadows.
events.quote: It was the Seer's Sundial, a massive stone hemispherium whose style and encircling metalwork projected shadows over a rune-inscribed bowl.

events.summary: Javad concludes the Sundial portends a future of darkness and resolves to seek researchers at Sea Gate and refuge at Graypelt.
events.quote: it portends a future that holds the true measure of darkness, for us and for all people under the sun

relations.quote: I've hired Ghazzan, the first minotaur I've expeditioned with, a nearly silent but unmistakably strong man who favors the Makindi longaxe to the more traditional machete

relations.note: Hired as the party's lullmage and bound by contract.
relations.quote: but I reminded her of my years of experience traveling the continent of Ondu, and of her contract.

relations.note: Hired as the party's goblin trapfinder.
relations.quote: and Keeda, "the Quick" as the advertisement read, a goblin trapfinder of the Lavastep tribe.

relations.note: The sundial stands on a hilltop dais in Turntimber.
relations.quote: overlooking the expanse of Turntimber like a lighthouse overlooking a sea of green waves
